title: The Body of the Cosmos and the Soul Bound
description: The deepest extent of the wound — and the New Man begun. T38 — the natural mind shaped as one anthropomorphic body, with the head at the highest firmament, the spine as the five storehouses, the heart as proper affection, the fire-wall of love as outer skin; five watchers stationed within. T39 — Adam molded from the Watchers' fallen residue, with the Lord going down to bear up what withered, the structural good giving way, the Pillar of Glory borne with weariness. T40 — the soul lives bound within twelve members of the body: mind in bone, thought in sinew, teaching in vein, counsel in flesh, reflection in skin, with the self's own five overlaid; until the Mind of Light performs the inverse exchange — raising each soul-faculty and binding the self's correlate in its place. This is the central wound of State 4 and the first real beginning of its repair.
